name: Vocational Training Fee reimbursement for the students belonging to Scheduled Caste category Students.
description: Vocational Training Fee reimbursement for the students belonging to Scheduled Caste Category students and admitted to the seats under PPP scheme in Government ITIs and Private ITIs through Centralized Admission Process. They will avail Fee Reimbursement benefit only if they met the Scheme Criteria.
department: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department
implementingAuthority: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department

criteria.label: 1. Admission taken through PPP scheme in Government Skill Development Institute or Private Institute and admitted through central Online Admission Process.

evidence.quote: 1. Admission taken through PPP scheme in Government Skill Development Institute or Private Institute and admitted through central Online Admission Process.

criteria.label: 2. No scholarship for Management Quota Admission

evidence.quote: 2. No scholarship for Management Quota Admission
3. Student should belong to Scheduled Caste Category (SC Category) and should provide caste certificate.
4. Overall Family Income Limit should be Rs.8.00 lacs
5. Orphan candidate requires Recommendation Letter.

criteria.label: 6. Candidate should not have taken any benefit for course previously from Government or Private ITI.

evidence.quote: 6. Candidate should not have taken any benefit for course previously from Government or Private ITI.

criteria.label: 7. Candidate should not have taken any benefit for training program sponsored by State / Central Government / Department / Local Body / Company or Corporation.

evidence.quote: 7. Candidate should not have taken any benefit for training program sponsored by State / Central Government / Department / Local Body / Company or Corporation.
8. Domicile of Maharashtra.

criteria.label: 9. Admission taken for DGT, New Delhi or MSCVT approved courses.

evidence.quote: 9. Admission taken for DGT, New Delhi or MSCVT approved courses.
10. Attendance criteria is mandatory.

criteria.label: 11. Candidate need to attend each semester /annual exam. If any medical emergency then after recommendation by institute Regional Joint Director should certify or recommend.

evidence.quote: 11. Candidate need to attend each semester /annual exam. If any medical emergency then after recommendation by institute Regional Joint Director should certify or recommend.

criteria.label: 12. Non Satisfactory educational progress due to misconduct- Failure in academic year, not fulfilling attendance criteria if found then candidate will not be eligible for scholarship.

evidence.quote: 12. Non Satisfactory educational progress due to misconduct- Failure in academic year, not fulfilling attendance criteria if found then candidate will not be eligible for scholarship.

benefits.text:
1. SSC Pass and Family income Less than or equal to 2,50,000 then As Per GOI scholarship.
2. SSC Pass and Family income above 2,50,000 to Less than or up to 8,00,000 Lakh then 100 % reimbursement of Course Fee.
3. SSC Fail and Family income up to 8,00,000 Lakh then 100 % reimbursement of Course Fee.

evidence.quote: 1. SSC Pass and Family income Less than or equal to 2,50,000 then As Per GOI scholarship.
Required Documents As per GR
1) Aadhaar Card.
2) Ration Card.
3) Mark sheet SSC /HSC.

documents.name: 4) Previous year mark sheet for renewal.

evidence.quote: 4) Previous year mark sheet for renewal.
5) Domicile certificate.
6) Income certificate by competent authority.
7) Caste certificate.

renewal:
i) The student have to be on roll in next year.
ii) Attendance is As per DGT criteria.
applicationProcess: For Academic Year 2026-27, apply on the MahaDBT 2.0 portal (fresh and renewal applications). The scheme page on MahaDBT 1.0 remains the information source.

applicationUrlEvidence.quote: Fresh and renewal applications for the Academic Year 2026-27 will be accepted only through the MahaDBT 2.0 Portal.
